A player with 46 [[Smithing]] can make them by using three [[steel bar]]s on an [[anvil]] while carrying a [[hammer]], granting 112.5 Smithing [[experience]]. They can also be bought from [[Louie's Armoured Legs Bazaar]]. They require 5 [[Defence]] to wear.

As they spawn in the [[Wilderness]] at the [[Ruins (east)|Ruins]] north of the [[Graveyard of Shadows]], they are one of the most easily accessible and most popular money making methods for new [[Ironman]] accounts when being sold to [[Louie's Armoured Legs Bazaar]] starting at 650 each at base stock of 2, reducing by 10 per extra set.

Their respawn rate in the Wilderness is between 10 and 20 minutes, depending on the number of players in a world.

This variant of the '''Torva platelegs''' is an unobtainable version of the regular [[Torva platelegs]], which resembles its appearance prior to the 3 August 2023 graphical update.

The [[Torva_armour#Appearance|graphical update to Torva armour]] was done with the reasoning that it was not "consistent with Old School's art style", and a non-trivial number of players disagreed with said change, mostly due to nostalgia towards its iconic appearance in its original release in ''RuneScape 2'' in 2011.

As such, this item was released as a compromise to allow the third party client [[RuneLite]] to use the assets for various plugins which changed the appearance of the player character (such as [https://runelite.net/plugin-hub/show/fashionscape Fashionscape] and [https://runelite.net/plugin-hub/show/weapon-animation-replacer Weapon/Gear/Animation Replacer]), although other players would not be able to see said player overriding their appearance.
